sms:3565751560036.note:
Our total weekly deductions are $500 — $400 for cargo and liability insurance, and $100 for ELD and IFTA service.
After that, there are no hidden charges, no forced dispatch, no trailer fee, and no escrow.
Our average rate is around $3 per mile, and our owner-operators typically gross around $9,000–$12,000 per week.
We mainly run Power Only and Dry Van freight, with a lot of drop-and-hook loads. Deadhead and empty miles can also be covered depending on the load.
If you don’t have your own plate, we can help provide one through our plate program.
We work with many major brokers and customers, including J.B. Hunt, FedEx, Schneider, Swift, and other large names.
Most of our loads are up to around 35,000 lbs, so we try to avoid extremely heavy or difficult freight.
We also provide 24/7 dispatch and support, so you’ll always have someone available if you need assistance on the road.
